about: people.json `boats` for S3 (the river agent, Run 2): how each boat painted under way moves and who works what (schema: gen/expand/boats_page_lessons.md, 'The crew'). The casting agent merges it into sections/rainbow_bridge/people.json. Crew standing on `boat deck:` / `boat roof:` need nothing here; moored boats need no entry. Clip names for the trackers (walk/stand) are placeholders for the casting agent: the needs list's tow_walk when it exists.

boat_under_way_15595.why: rowed by its great sweep (摇橹向前), heading west-north-west toward S4b's raft: S4b's sterns lie 0.3 m off its bow at rest, so its run is cut from the default 8 m to 1 m (it sculls forward a metre and drifts back); the sweep sculls while it moves
boat_under_way_15595.crew_note: the three bowmen's layout support is 'boat bow deck:', which the page's host doesn't parse (it reads 'boat deck:' and 'boat roof:'): listed here without work so the page hosts them on this boat's deck; their painted raised bow deck (H 1.12) waits on the kit factory's B9

boat_towed_mast_16228.why: towed east by the five trackers on the far bank, the tow line from its masthead made fast to the rear man (tracker_16333, the map): 4 m (default 8) so that its bow stays 0.3 m clear of the mat-cabin boat moored at the hall on stilts; the trackers walk the same 4 m with it

boat_cabin_under_arch_19225.why: painted drifting under the arch: 3 m west along its heading and back (default 4), its mat awning under the soffit all the way (crown 1.8 m above the water under a soffit of 2.4-3.6 m)

boat_mast_lowering_19518.why: 大船抢险: the mast going down and up again is its motion (24 s); its run is 0 (the area agent's call): its bow lies 0.4 m outside the arch's near face, and its curled stem post (3.1 m above the water) can't pass under the face anywhere (soffit less the facing timber, 3.23 m at the crown) | area agent: run_m 0.2, not 0: boats.js divides by the travel time, and 0 gives NaN matrices on the frame its state changes (QA, probe/nan3.js); 0.2 m keeps the bow 0.2 m off the arch's near face at the end of its run | run 3 finisher: pause_s [3600, 3]: it rests at its painted spot with its contacts open while its mast goes down and up (the painted motion, mast_cycle_s, runs on its own clock); with the default 8 s pauses its 0.2 m outings closed and reopened its bank bridge under the arch, and 2 of 14 walkers boarding there ended 0.4 m out in the water (qa/run3/wade.log)

crew_nudges.about: people.json figures[].nudge [dX, dD] (metres) for the crew, from the river agent: each crew figure's painted place along and across its boat's painted waterline, carried proportionally onto the built hull (real size: the boat under way is built 12 m against its painted 4.5 m, so its bowmen would otherwise stand amidships under the mat roof; the towed boat 12 m against 2.5 m end-on, its poler at the bow and the two men on the laden mound), held within 0.35 of the beam of the centre line; on top of the layout's spot (already moved with the boat). The sweep crew need none (the page stands them at the sweep's bar). Apply or adjust: the page brings any spot off the hull in to the centre line anyway.
